# zombie-mermaid

> Render Mermaid diagrams as themeable SVG or ASCII/Unicode art. Zero DOM dependencies. A maintained fork of beautiful-mermaid.

- [Sample gallery and live demo](https://dfadler.github.io/zombie-mermaid/)
- [Diagram types](https://dfadler.github.io/zombie-mermaid/diagrams/)
- [Editor](https://dfadler.github.io/zombie-mermaid/editor)
- [Blog](https://dfadler.github.io/zombie-mermaid/blog/)

- [Docs index](https://github.com/dfadler/zombie-mermaid/blob/main/docs/README.md)

- [Migrating from beautiful-mermaid](https://github.com/dfadler/zombie-mermaid/blob/main/docs/migrating-from-beautiful-mermaid.md)

## CLI and MCP server

- [CLI](https://github.com/dfadler/zombie-mermaid/blob/main/packages/cli/README.md): `npx @zombie-mermaid/cli render diagram.mmd --ascii` renders SVG, ASCII, PNG or a self-contained HTML viewer from the terminal
- [MCP server](https://github.com/dfadler/zombie-mermaid/blob/main/packages/mcp/README.md): `zombie-mermaid mcp` serves rendering and validation tools to MCP clients over stdio
- [MCP tool reference](https://github.com/dfadler/zombie-mermaid/blob/main/docs/mcp-tools.md): arguments and return shapes for each tool, including `list_diagram_types` (the supported diagram types and their keywords)
